title: IBM Design Language / Home

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Connect the governing idea to the tools used to express it, so designers can understand why separate ingredients belong to one system.
strategic_value: The Build Bonds statement beside links to Plex, color and imagery can make IBM’s identity feel like a coordinated practice.
demonstration: The webpage pairs a filmed hero state and the Think → Guide ethos with a grid of design-topic cards, practical resources and recent type releases.
practical_value: Use the home page as a map from brand philosophy to the specific guidance needed for a task.

content_islands.name: Hero gateways
content_islands.spec: Place Philosophy and Gallery links over the large photographic video state at the top.

content_islands.name: Governing ethos
content_islands.spec: Set Think → Guide beside Build Bonds and its short explanation below the hero.

content_islands.name: Design topics
content_islands.spec: Arrange illustrated cards for typeface, philosophy, color, photography, illustration and 2x Grid in a varied grid.

content_islands.name: Working resources
content_islands.spec: Follow with a compact grid of links to type, color, grid, icons, illustration and Carbon tools.

content_islands.name: Recent releases
content_islands.spec: Close the main editorial content with three dated Plex release cards before the site navigation and footer.

reference_purposes.Intent: The home copy identifies Build Bonds as the ethos that distinguishes every IBM element and experience.
reference_purposes.Expression: Topic cards show Plex letterforms, the rebus, a color spectrum, photography and isometric illustration together.
reference_purposes.Application: Resource cards connect the ethos to specific assets and design tools.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
